mapper.select: select student_code as studentCode, user_id as userId, student_id as studentId, college_dept_id as collegeId from talk_student_account where user_id = #{userId}
select student_code as studentCode, user_id as userId, student_id as studentId, college_dept_id as collegeId from talk_student_account where student_id = #{studentId}
mapper.update: update talk_student_account set student_code = #{studentCode}, college_dept_id = #{collegeId} where user_id = #{userId} and student_id = #{studentId}

update sys_user u join talk_student_account a on a.user_id = u.user_id set u.user_name = #{studentCode}, u.update_time = now() where u.user_id = #{userId} and a.student_id = #{studentId} and u.del_flag = '0'
mapper.insert: insert ignore into talk_student_account (student_code, user_id, student_id, college_dept_id) values (#{studentCode}, #{userId}, #{studentId}, #{collegeId})

insert ignore into talk_class_manager (class_dept_id, teacher_id, create_time) select d.dept_id, t.teacher_id, now() from talk_teacher t join talk_teacher_class tc on tc.teacher_code = t.teacher_code join sys_dept d on d.dept_name = tc.class_name and d.dept_type = 'class' and d.del_flag = '0' where t.teacher_id = #{teacherId} and find_in_set(t.dept_id, d.ancestors) and not exists (select 1 from talk_class_manager cm join sys_dept precise on precise.dept_id = cm.class_dept_id where cm.teacher_id = t.teacher_id and precise.dept_name = tc.class_name)
mapper.select: select (exists(select 1 from talk_student_manager where student_id = #{studentId} and teacher_id = #{teacherId}) and exists(select 1 from talk_class_manager where class_dept_id = #{classDeptId} and teacher_id = #{teacherId}))
mapper.insert: insert ignore into talk_student_manager (student_id, teacher_id, create_time) values (#{studentId}, #{teacherId}, now())
insert ignore into talk_class_manager (class_dept_id, teacher_id, create_time) values (#{classDeptId}, #{teacherId}, now())
insert ignore into talk_teacher_class (teacher_code, class_name, create_time) values (#{teacherCode}, #{className}, now())
mapper.select: select t.teacher_id, t.teacher_code, t.teacher_name, t.dept_id, t.position, t.user_id, t.status from talk_student_manager m join talk_student s on s.student_id = m.student_id join talk_teacher t on t.teacher_id = m.teacher_id join sys_dept d on d.dept_id = s.dept_id where m.student_id = #{studentId} and (t.dept_id = d.dept_id or find_in_set(t.dept_id, d.ancestors)) order by t.teacher_code
